subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the amount of loan given by each of seven different banks as a percentage of the total loan given by these 7 banks taken together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91f0d0e83f6b401566187ad91db9708ec75d8516182a48133c640c1ec1fe170c.png] 

What will be the angle made by sector B2?
solution:
Calculations:

According to the question,

100% = 360°

Then, 17%

⇒ 360° × 17/100

⇒ 61.2°

Hence, The Required value is 61.2°.
